notes.title: [Patch 4.0] Slime Joins The Fight!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2VoUr5O.gif[/img]

[b][h1]New game features[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] new playable character 'Slime'
[*] New win/rematch screen
[*] new character select screen
[*] new V.S screen with dialogue
[*] more character colors
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/502zw96.png[/img]

[b][h2]New battle features[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] regain all used moves on knockdown (otg)
[*] higher otg launch
[*] improved invul system for anitairs/projectiles etc.
[*] hitbox priority system
[*] new gravity scaling system for combos. starter move and individual moves after all have their own scaling values
[*] new damage scaling for combos.  starter move and individual moves after all have their own scaling values
[/list]

[b][h2]Quality of Life changes[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Dualsense (ps5) controllers work natively
[*] training mode quick reset inputs + position reset added
[*] training mode input frame count
can be done by holding the [select/option/F1] button and pressing Light/Medium/Heavy/Dodge.
[*] new training mode damage & proration display
[*] movelist darker colors
[*] character color palette number added to character select
[/list]

[b][h2]Bug fixes[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] issue with blocking mid [blue burst]
[*] [blue burst] inconsistency fixes
[*] hurtbox and hitbox inconsistencies
[*] issue with special inputs being buffered on wake up
[*] final hit during matches keeps player standing bug
[*] button configuration menu issues fixed
[/list]

[h1]Character changes[/h1]

[i]The following information will be updated shortly with more detailed numbers for future reference.[/i]

[b][h2]General character changes[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] all characters can now combo from their [grab] with a specific move (character specific)
[*] [grab] starter combos damage scaling nerfed
[*] all [standing light] and [crouching light] attacks starter damage scaling decreased
[/list]

[b]Zaiva[/b]
[list]
[*] Health value changed from 2400 > 2600
[*] [c. forward heavy] 2 frames faster start up
[*] [c. forward heavy] more forward momentum
[*] [forward special B] faster startup
[*] [forward specials] kunai increased vertical hitbox
[*] [grab] can now combo into [special back B]
[/list]

[b] Nosferatu[/b]
[list]
[*] health value changed from 2800 > 3000
[*] [grab] combo starter damage scaling reduced
[/list]

[b]Gangco[/b]
[list]
[*] health value changed from 2300 > 2400
[*] all clones health reduced
[*] [universal overhead] more upwards knockback
[*] [standing heavy] more upwards knockback
[*] [Special forward B] more upwards knockback
[*] [Special forward A] now launches upwards instead of down
[*] [grab] can now combo into [special forward A]
[/list]

[b]Mr. No. 5[/b]
[list]
[*] Health value changed from 2300 > 2500
[*] [special forward A] bomb no longer launches and has decreased knockback
[*] [crouching medium] decreased knockback & increased recovery
[*] all round projectile damage decrease
[/list]

[b]Hitboxer[/b]
[list]
[*] Health value changed from 2500 > 2700
[*] [special forward A/B] combo damage scaling decreased
[*] [special forward A] animation change
[*] [special forward A] more forward momentum
[*] [grab] can now combo into 8B
[/list]

[b]Skullion[/b]
[list]
[*] Health value changed from 2700 > 2800
[*] skullion heavy starter proration decreased 0.9> 0.8
[*] skullion heavy C starter proration increased 0.9 > 1
[*] [c. forward Mdeium] first hit is now low
[/list]

[b]Mirmo[/b]
[list]
[*] grab can now combo into 2C
[*] [universal overhead] more upwards knockback
[*] allround increased damage
[/list]

Manta
[list]
[*] Health value changed from 3000 > 3200
[*] [crouch medium] now has 2 hiboxes, close one pushes slightly forward, far hitbox pulls in
[*] [c. forward heavy]  damage decreased from 200> 100
[*] [crouch heavy] last hit knockback decreased, launch hieight increase
[*] [special forward B] now dash cancelable on hit
[*] [special back B] no longer cancels into itself
[/list]

Ciel

[*] [standing heavy] more upwards momentum + pulls in more

Kern

notes.title: Third time's a Charm [Hotfix 3.0]
notes.content:
Back at it again, 3rd day in a row haha.

got a lot of adjustments to announce for this patch, a lot of things where inconsistent and not working as intended. These things were mainly things youd come across when playing against someone rather than in training mod sessions.

here we go:

[h2][b]Fixed Bugs[/b][/h2]
- infinite dash cancel glitch removed ✔️
- universal overheads are now aerial projectile invulnerable and can destroy aerial projectiles as intended.✔️
- all character attacks are now correctly labeled as high/mid/low/overhead.✔️
- invulnerability working as intended now✔️
- when getting interrupted out of armor, hitstun wouldn't work, this works now✔️
- characters can no longer be pushed far back when in the middle of their universal overhead✔️
- zaiva forward special A teleport bug removed✔️
- kern lvl 2 super would miss if opponent was in the corner, now fixed✔️
- gangco was unable to cancel standing light into forward special A, now fixed✔️
- red burst no longer counts as a hit in combos.✔️
- grab teching would completely miss the opponent and not work.✔️

[h2][b]Balance Adjustments[/b][/h2]
- combo scaling now works as intended:
      - Red burst always sets the combo scaling to 70% (it used to reset to 
         100%)
      - supers now have a minimum damage threshold of 50% (it used to 
         reset to 100%)
- reduced burst gain when hit by opponent

[b]Gangco[/b]
- gangco back special A damage reduced from 310 > 280
- gangco forward special B damage reduced from 300 > 250
- gangco all specials combo starter property lowered. (less damage when starting combo with these moves)

[b]Manta[/b]
- manta standing light startup increased
- manta standing heavy startup increased
- manta standing heavy decreased armor hits from 2 > 1
- manta down+forward heavy projectile arm gets destroyed if manta is hit
- manta lvl 1 super more consistent launch knockback
- manta forward special A/B projectiles get destroyed when manta is hit
- manta forward special B projectile has less health now and can be destroyed by other projectiles

[b]Mirmo[/b]
- special back B counter is now faster, can now properly punish moste medium and all heavy/special attacks.

[b]Nosferatu[/b]
- nosferatu down heavy no longer cancels into itself, preventing infinits
- nosferatu down heavy recovery increased
- nosferatu back special A recovery reduced

[b]Skullion[/b]
- skullion down+forward medium second hit is now a low


phew... this took me ages to write down😂

hope these fixes help up the overal experience!

if this patch is stable enough i will be getting to new features soon!!!

stay safe,

GxGrainSon. (Developer)

notes.title: 2nd Patch [Hotfix 2.0]
notes.content:
Thank you all for the amazing feedback and patience! i got another couple of bugs out of the way :D

[h2]Fixed Bugs[/h2]

[b]Inputs[/b]
- when accidentally inputting back > forward when trying to perform specials characters would dash cancel, this is removed ✔️
- menu sfx would play every time you pressed the button even though you were in the middle of fighting✔️

[b]Pause menu[/b]
- pausing and unpausing the game a couple times cause the pause screen to stop functioning properly, characters would no longer freeze their velocity✔️

[b]loading screen jitter[/b]
- character sprite while loading looked jittery✔️


I think thats all for now. Still getting used to keeping track of changes and reporting them so bare with me yall :]

stay safe!

- GxGrainSon. (developer)

notes.title: First Patch!! [Hotfix]
notes.content:
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

[h1]Fixed bugs[/h1]
[b]Button config[/b]
- player 2 joystick config screen showed keyboard controls✔️
- controller config issue where you could not remap the [A] button on a controller(partially fixed✔️)
(this will get fixed properly once i get some sleep T-T)

[b]Game Settings[/b]
- volume would start at 0 when booting the game for the first time✔️
- resolution would be very low when booting the game for the first time✔️
- volume sounded quiet even at max volume✔️

[b]Movelist[/b]
- inconsistencies in move list descriptions✔️
- Mr. N0. 5 movelist showing "zaiva" in the character name section✔️
- move list navigation got stuck some times✔️

[b]Pause menu[/b]
- you can now press back to exit pause menu✔️

[b]Characters[/b]
- Nosferatus supers now breaks burst like all other characters✔️
- spamming burst on grab no longer freezes character velocity✔️

i will be fixing more bugs during this first week of release and will slowly build up to adding new features once the major issues are fixed!

hope everyone is having fun with the game so far :]

- GxGrainson (Developer)
